question: Should OpenClaw establish a permanent top-level `auth` namespace that currently contains only an alias for model-auth listing?
rationale: The code can delegate safely, but choosing a second public CLI hierarchy and its future scope requires explicit product and compatibility ownership.

options.title: Keep the model-owned hierarchy
options.body: Decline the alias and keep provider-profile operations exclusively under `openclaw models auth`, improving discoverability without duplicating the API.

options.title: Sponsor top-level auth
options.body: Approve `openclaw auth` as an intentional public namespace and define whether other model-auth operations will eventually be exposed there.

recommendation.title: Keep the model-owned hierarchy
recommendation.body: Decline the alias and keep provider-profile operations exclusively under `openclaw models auth`, improving discoverability without duplicating the API.

likelyOwner.reason: Release history most directly connects this person to the existing model-auth listing command and its intended CLI surface.
